import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_soi_individual_returns_by_state_us.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)
# Row 9 (index 8): Number of returns [1], column B (index 1) is All returns
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains(r'^Number of returns', regex=True)].iloc[0]
result = int(row[1])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_soi_individual_returns_by_state_us.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)
single_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Number of single returns', regex=False)].iloc[0]
joint_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Number of joint returns', regex=False)].iloc[0]
single_val = float(single_row[1])
joint_val = float(joint_row[1])
result = 'yes' if single_val > joint_val else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_soi_individual_returns_by_state_us.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)
bracket_row = df.iloc[4, 2:12] # Excel row 5 has AGI brackets
e_file_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Number of electronically filed returns', regex=False)].iloc[0, 2:12]
max_col = e_file_row.astype(float).idxmax()
result = str(bracket_row[max_col]).strip()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_soi_individual_returns_by_state_us.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)
brackets = df.iloc[4, 2:12].tolist()
eic_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Earned income credit:.*Number', regex=True)].iloc[0, 2:12]
s = pd.Series(eic_row.astype(float).values, index=brackets)
result = s.nlargest(3).index.tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('irs_soi_individual_returns_by_state_us.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=None)
before_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Income tax before credits:', regex=False)].index[0]
after_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Income tax after credits:', regex=False)].index[0]
# Amount rows are immediately following the Number rows
before_amt = float(df.iloc[before_idx + 1, 1])
after_amt = float(df.iloc[after_idx + 1, 1])
result = int(before_amt - after_amt)
